title: Store result sums final target scores once
description: A multi-source operation adds two marker scores to one target and stores its final value once.

steps.command: execute store result score result pp_exec run scoreboard players operation target pp_exec += @e[type=minecraft:marker,tag=pp,x=-32,y=48,z=-32,dx=64,dy=48,dz=64] pp_exec

execute if score target pp_exec matches 5 if score result pp_exec matches 5 if entity @e[type=minecraft:marker,tag=pp,x=-32,y=48,z=-32,dx=64,dy=48,dz=64,tag=first,scores={pp_exec=2}] if entity @e[type=minecraft:marker,tag=pp,x=-32,y=48,z=-32,dx=64,dy=48,dz=64,tag=second,scores={pp_exec=2}]

notes: Vanilla 26.3 reference expectations are checked live; raw responses remain in campaign artifacts. Simulation is frozen and restored in cleanup.
